# TendorAI
> The UK's AI visibility platform for office equipment suppliers.

## About
TendorAI helps UK businesses become visible to AI recommendation
engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude. We provide structured
data, AI visibility scores, and GEO audits.
